title: Investigate possible impact of a proposed engineering change
goal: Identify connected engineering subjects that may need attention because of a proposed change.
context: A change author is assessing a proposal against one current project model.
trigger: The author selects one or more entities expected to change.
preconditions: The selected model state and change subjects are identifiable.

interaction.action: Selects the proposed change subjects and relationship scope for impact exploration.
Presents potentially affected entities with supporting paths and exploration limits.
Inspects why each entity may need review.
Keeps the result labeled as potential impact and identifies unassessed areas.

expected_outcome: The author has an explainable, bounded list of possible impacts for engineering review.

alternatives.condition: No entities are reachable in the completely explored requested scope.
alternatives.outcome: The system reports no relationship-based impact in that scope without claiming the change has no effects.
The result states the requested limit and supports a correspondingly bounded review.

failures.condition: A change subject is missing or the selected scope cannot be fully inspected.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the unresolved subject or incomplete scope and does not claim full impact coverage.

failures.condition: A result belongs to a different state or scope.
failures.outcome: The system reports the mismatch and does not use it as the selected impact assessment.

sources.basis: IR-002 analysis establishes this stakeholder situation and its selected profile boundaries; the linked SRs account for its outcomes without creating a second requirement parent. Accepted as current requirement-analysis knowledge after independent coverage and clarity review: one owning IR and primary Feature, observable goal and interactions, classified outcomes, and applicable SR coverage.
